name: Taki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Taki town emblem in green and orange: a green stylised bird-like swoosh with an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Taki, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2006.

features.role: Taki town emblem — a green stylised bird-like swoosh with an orange disc
